title: Simple Parties
description: Modern party plugin for Paper servers with invites, party chat, roles, public browser, warps, homes, leveling, and social integrations.
body:
# SimpleParties

SimpleParties is a modern and feature-rich party plugin for Minecraft servers that helps players group up, stay social, and play together.

Perfect for survival servers, SMPs, minigames, RPG servers, and community networks.

## Features

- ✔ Create and manage parties
- ✔ Invite / accept / deny system
- ✔ Party chat
- ✔ Party roles (Leader, Co-Leader, Moderator, Member)
- ✔ Public party browser
- ✔ Party warp requests
- ✔ Shared party home
- ✔ Ready checks
- ✔ Party descriptions
- ✔ Privacy modes
- ✔ Party leveling system
- ✔ Optional shared rewards
- ✔ GUI menus with player heads
- ✔ Configurable messages and sounds
- ✔ Lightweight and optimized

## Commands

- /party
- /party create
- /party invite <player>
- /party accept <player>
- /party leave
- /party kick <player>
- /party promote <player>
- /party transfer <player>
- /party browse
- /party warp
- /party home
- /party sethome
- /party ready

## Party Privacy Modes

* Invite Only
* Friends Only
* Public
* Hidden

## Optional Integrations

Works with:

* SimpleFriends
* SimpleProfiles

More integrations planned in future updates.

## Compatibility

Supports Minecraft 1.21.x servers running:

* Paper
* Purpur
* Pufferfish
* Spigot

## Perfect For

Survival servers
SMP servers
Minigame servers
Dungeon / RPG servers
Community servers

## Planned Updates

* Discord support
* Queue integrations
* More cosmetics
* Expanded rewards
* More profile features

## Support

Need help, found a bug, or have suggestions? Join my Discord.
